summary: Ukraine proposed a Black Sea ceasefire to Russia, which has not yet responded. Russian forces reported liberating Petrovka in the DPR and striking targets in Odesa, Chornomorsk, and Ochakiv. Ukrainian drones attacked Moscow and Leningrad regions, causing damage at the Port of Ust-Luga.
key_points: Ukraine proposed a Black Sea ceasefire to Russia through a third party, with no response received yet. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32441)
Russian Ministry of Defense reported the liberation of Petrovka in the DPR. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32420)
Ukrainian drones attacked Moscow and Leningrad regions overnight, damaging the Port of Ust-Luga and prompting flight disruptions. (Source: @UkraineNow/83418)
Russian forces struck fuel depots in the Kiev region and destroyed military targets in Odesa, Chornomorsk, and Ochakiv. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)
Ukrainian SBU exposed an agent network of 14 individuals spying on F-16 and Mirage 2000 aircraft, blocking 4 Telegram channels. (Source: @UkraineNow/83413)
Russian forces claimed to have driven the 129th Territorial Defense Battalion out of Vodyanoye in the Kharkiv direction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)
Fighting continues in multiple eastern front areas including Stepnogorsk, Primorskoye, Lukyanovskoye, and Yurkovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment remains highly volatile with simultaneous cross-border drone attacks and frontline advances. Ukraine's Black Sea ceasefire proposal indicates potential diplomatic maneuvering while kinetic operations continue. Russian forces demonstrate capability to strike deep into Ukrainian territory including Odesa port infrastructure. Ukrainian drone strikes on Moscow and Leningrad regions show expanded reach into Russian interior. Agent network exposure reveals ongoing intelligence competition with both sides actively targeting air assets and infrastructure.
sections.regional_response: Polish relations with Ukraine face strain following incidents involving Ukrainian refugees, including a case where a family left after their daughter was assaulted. Germany has ceased protection for new Ukrainian male refugees of conscription age who did not serve. International automotive federation lifted restrictions on Russian and Belarusian drivers. These developments suggest shifting European attitudes toward Ukrainian refugees and Russian reintegration in international sports.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian SBU successfully penetrated and exposed a 14-person agent network targeting F-16 and Mirage 2000 aircraft intelligence gathering. The network utilized high-quality cameras and Telegram channels near airbases for reconnaissance. Russian FSB reported sentencing a citizen to 23 years for providing Polish intelligence with weapons sample data. Cross-border drone operations by both sides indicate sustained intelligence and operational capabilities extending into adversary territory. Multiple Telegram channels were blocked as part of counter-intelligence operations.
